name: rainbow-button

frames.best_why: The rainbow glow is widest under the button and no cursor covers the label or edge.

tagline: A white pill button with a rainbow glow sliding along its lower edge.
summary: A rounded white button with dark text, trimmed by a thin animated rainbow border that blurs into a soft coloured halo under the bottom edge.
appearance: A white rounded rectangle with black, medium-weight text sits on a black stage. A thin rainbow line runs along its edge, blue through pink to red, and a blurred copy of that gradient bleeds out below the bottom like a soft light.
behaviour: The rainbow gradient slides sideways on a loop, so the trim and the glow beneath slowly change hue. Pressing nothing changes it; it also gets a focus ring and a dimmed disabled look from its classes.
search_phrases: button with a rainbow border glow
colorful shimmer along the bottom edge
white button with animated rainbow outline
glowing rainbow light under a button
soft multicoloured halo behind a pill
button with a moving gradient trim
use_when: A prominent action wants a colourful celebratory accent while its label stays plain and legible.
avoid_when: Serious or brand-strict pages where a multicoloured glow clashes, and dark themes where a white body glares.
customise: The label is children; variant, size, asChild and className are props, while the five rainbow colours are CSS variables defined in the source.
weight_why: One button with two CSS gradients and a blurred pseudo-element on a single keyframe.

a11y.note: The rainbow slides forever and is not paused for users who ask for reduced motion.

issues: Against the dark stage the rainbow glow is faint and often reads as a grey shadow.
polish_why: Distinctive trim and glow with clean spacing; the colour is subdued on black.
